name: Semantic and visual region alignment
summary: Expose the visible hierarchy of main, supporting, navigational and section content through coherent programmatic regions and descriptive headings.
problem: A composition can visually suggest regions while its programmatic structure fails to expose corresponding relationships.
context: Document-like or app pages whose main content, navigation and supporting areas can be meaningfully distinguished.
observed_solution: Use meaningful hierarchy through heading labels/levels, appropriate programmatic landmarks and visually consistent region presentation, without assuming one wrapper per subsection.
rationale: WCAG requires programmatically determinable presentation relationships (O01) and descriptive headings (O05); WAI explains navigable headings/landmarks (O06–O09); Primer docs and pinned PageLayout show region APIs and landmark naming intent (O24–O26,O29).
tradeoffs: Too many landmarks or headings for trivial fragments can reduce their navigational usefulness.
Visual headings can span flexible sections, so heading levels require contextual information architecture.
applicability: Multi-region pages with meaningful main/navigation/complementary content.
non_applicability: Pure decoration, transient microgrouping or layout wrappers without separate content purpose.
accessibility_implications: Semantic relationships and headings must be programmatic where WCAG applies; component source is not a conformance test.
responsive_implications: Region reading order and meaning should be checked independently as layout is rearranged.
implementation_notes: Use existing semantic HTML where applicable; exact framework/component not prescribed.
Not every visual card is an ARIA region.

counterexamples.summary: A decorative visual divider or small formatting group need not become a separate named page landmark.
counterexamples.context: Single narrative within an already named main region.

version_context: WCAG 2.2 Recommendation (2024); WAI/Primer live unpinned docs; primer/react fixed commit 7f5303d803986887187d86dcebaeda22a4dc6823
